ns2:section.sectionText: Prerequisites will be enforced. This course will open to all Business Administration majors on Monday, November 17, 2014 and to Finance majors on Monday, November 24, 2014 at approximately 9:00 a.m. This course will open to Informatics Minors on Monday, December 1, 2014 at approximately 9:00 a.m. There are currently 10 reserved seats for College of Business international exchange students; any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, January 23, 2015 at approximately 9:00 a.m.
